query: SELECT ROUND(ABS(AVG(CASE WHEN p.price IS NOT NULL THEN r.rating END) - AVG(CASE WHEN p.price IS NULL THEN r.rating END)), 2) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.category = p.category AND r.ref_id = p.ref_id WHERE p.category = 'musical instruments'
